page_title: HEI 3-2 FRE | Heidenheim v Freiburg 20/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+8' A quickly taken corner by Heidenheim.
90+7' Heidenheim work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+7' Heidenheim quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+2' The corner is swung in but Freiburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+2' 3 - 2 What bad luck! Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) got in the way of a pass and unintentionally sent the ball past his own goalkeeper. The score is 3:2.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
89' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
86' It looks like Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim) saw red with that tackle. Benjamin Brand won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
84' 2 - 2 Goal! Stefan Schimmer puts the ball across the area and Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 2:2.
84' Christian Streich has decided to make a change. Junior Adamu (Freiburg) replaces Roland Sallai.
84' Substitution. Lukas Kubler is replaced by Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg).
83' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Heidenheim.
81' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Heidenheim comes to nothing.
81' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
76' The foul by Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Benjamin Brand.
75' The attendance for today's match is 15000.
75' Frank Schmidt decides to make a substitution. Lennard Maloney will be replaced by Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim).
74' Today's match ends for Marnon Busch who will be replaced by Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim).
74' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Benedikt Gimber as he is replaced by Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim).
72' Rough tackle by Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
71' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
69' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
68' Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) brings his opponent down. Benjamin Brand has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marvin Pieringer trots off the pitch and is replaced by Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim).
67' Frank Schmidt has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) replacing Adrian Beck.
65' Merlin Rohl goes off the pitch and Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) comes on.
64' 1 - 2 Lucas Holer (Freiburg) keeps his cool and scores from the penalty spot.
64' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
64' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.

63' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Benjamin Brand blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. PENALTY! One of the players from Freiburg is about to take a penalty kick. Let's see how this ends.
61' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Benjamin Brand blows for a foul.
60' A yellow card for a tackle by Merlin Rohl (Freiburg). Benjamin Brand doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
57' The linesman signals that Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
56' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.

52' 1 - 1 Goal! Tim Kleindienst sets up Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) for a shot on the edge of the box. He doesn't hit the cleanest of shots, but the ball somehow finds its way into the top left corner. 1:1.
51' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
50' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
50' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
49' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) tackles a bit over-zealously and Benjamin Brand blows for a foul.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' The corner kick from Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle. Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) commits a foul after dangerous play.
39' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
37' A yellow-coloured card is received by Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim).
36' The whistle blows and Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) is booked for an infringement.
33' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Benjamin Brand ignores the protests.
32' Heidenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
32' Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Heidenheim force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
30' Freiburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
28' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) commits a rough challenge and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul.
24' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) was too forceful with his tackle and Benjamin Brand interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
23' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
22' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle and signals a foul after Roland Sallai (Freiburg) brought his opponent down.
21' Benjamin Brand has a clear sight and sees a foul from Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim).
19' The referee blows his whistle as Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) was too aggressive in his challenge.
18' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) sends a cross into the box, but Noah Atubolu comes off his line to gather the ball.
15' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for an infringement.
14' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
13' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Kevin Muller intercepts the ball.
7' 0 - 1 It's 0:1! Merlin Rohl feeds Lucas Holer (Freiburg) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
6' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Marnon Busch (Heidenheim), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the left post. What a chance!
5' Benjamin Brand shows a yellow card to Manuel Gulde (Freiburg) for a tough tackle.
3' Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Heidenheim will have the kick-off.
Benjamin Brand is introduced as the referee for today's match.
